latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Quickly generate and export 60-second YouTube videos from scripts, images, or audio — no editing software needed.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files up to 200MB; cloud backend handles all editing, background music, and transitions.
- Free anonymous usage with 100 credits valid for 7 days, session management and status notifications included.
- Download completed videos (MP4, 1080p H.264), check credit balance, and manage workflow in 1–2 minutes per export.
- Smart error handling, guided workflows, and timeline summaries to make editing efficient and beginner-friendly.
